title: Coast Guard CEDT Explain Equipment Used During Vertical Delivery Hoist
description: Coast Guard canine explosive detection team explains the equipment their K-9s wear during a vertical delivery hoist.
keywords: K-9\'s, Maritime Safety and Security Team, Coast Guard, explosive
